summary: Rows, field labels and md field values follow compact density (ADR 0025); default and comfortable are unchanged (all visual cases byte-identical at default). Under data-ui-density="compact": Menu and ContextMenu rows (the menu-surface recipe) and Select, Combobox and Multiselect options are 32px with an 8px inline inset, at 13/400 (text-row; Multiselect keeps its 12px type), and menu group labels ride the same lane; Sidebar items, section headings and the layer title are 32px at 13px (text-nav-row → body-sm), the profile name 13px, the search value 13px, every label on a 16px lane matching the compact search field; NavRail items are 28px squares centred on the rail (the slot keeps 32px); field labels of Input, Textarea, Select, Multiselect, Combobox, DatePicker, ColorPicker and ImageUpload are 12/600 (text-field-label → label-sm); the md value of Input, Select, Combobox, Multiselect and Textarea is 13px (text-row), lg keeps 14. A consumer that passed className="p-sm text-body-sm" to Menu.Item for density can drop it; it still merges and wins if kept. The density visual case changes (its compact Input), so its baselines need regenerating. Requires the regenerated theme from the token entry of the same date.
